mix: short road trips to Hunza, flight-based circuits, and grand tours that take in Hunza, Skardu, Fairy Meadows, Deosai and the Ghizer valleys
top_html:
Gilgit tour package prices in 2026

Most people searching for a "Gilgit tour" mean a trip around Gilgit-Baltistan - Hunza, Skardu, Fairy Meadows and the valleys around them. Here is what those trips cost in 2026, per person unless noted (always confirm the current rate):

Type of tripTypical 2026 price
Budget group trip by road, 5-8 daysPublished from about Rs 17,500 (Hunza, 5 days) to Rs 25,500 (Skardu, 8 days)
Private trip with your own car and driver - HunzaAbout Rs 29,500 (3 days), Rs 49,500 (5 days), Rs 69,500 (7 days)
Skardu group trip by road, 7-8 daysAbout Rs 29,500-39,500
Skardu by air, 4-6 daysAbout Rs 63,000-145,000
Guided tours for foreign visitorsAbout US$850 (Hunza, 7-9 days) to US$1,050-1,850 (11-17 day circuits)
Honeymoon packages, 5-8 daysRs 120,000-190,000 per package, as listed

What changes the price: flying instead of driving (flights cost about PKR 18,000-30,000 each way), a private car instead of a shared group vehicle, the hotel level, and the season - blossom (late March to mid-April) and autumn (late September to October) are the busiest. Travelling from Lahore adds about PKR 6,900-8,400 each way by coach; from Karachi, PIA flies direct to Skardu about 3-4 times a week, or you can connect through Islamabad.

Want a specific destination? See my comparisons of Hunza tour packages, Skardu tour packages and Fairy Meadows tour packages.

day_groups.label: 5-8 days
day_groups.why: One or two regions by road - Hunza, or Hunza and Skardu - with long drives at each end.

day_groups.label: 10-13 days
day_groups.why: Hunza plus Fairy Meadows, or Skardu, Khaplu and Hunza with a flight - the sweet spot for a first trip.

day_groups.label: 15 days or more
day_groups.why: The full circuit: add Chapursan, the Ghizer valleys (Phander, Yasin, Ishkoman) or Deosai and Astore.

days_tip: Whatever the length, keep one spare day for a cancelled flight or a landslide - Machulo's spring tour builds one in, which is a good sign.
footer_html: Starting from a particular city? See tours from Islamabad, from Lahore and from Karachi.
notes: UK travel advice (FCDO) warns against all travel on the KKH between Mansehra and Chilas. If that applies to you, choose a trip that flies, or uses the Babusar road (open roughly late May to October).

packages.name: 5-Day Hunza, Gilgit & Khunjerab Trip
packages.best: The shortest trip to Hunza and Khunjerab

Chilas to Hunza, stopping where three mountain ranges meet and at the Nanga Parbat and Rakaposhi viewpoints.
Baltit or Altit Fort, Attabad Lake through the tunnels, the Passu Cones and - if possible, by jeep - Khunjerab Pass.
Back down to Chilas or Besham.
Early start to Islamabad (about 5pm), continuing to Lahore (around midnight).

No price shown - ask on WhatsApp

packages.best: Hunza and Skardu in one week by road
itinerary: Islamabad through Balakot and Naran, past Lulusar Lake and over Babusar Pass to Chilas.
A long day from Chilas to Skardu, via the Nanga Parbat viewpoint and the three-ranges junction.
Shigar: the cold desert, Blind Lake (from a distance) and Shigar Fort, plus Manthokha waterfall.
By 4x4 to Deosai via Satpara Lake: Bara Pani and Sheosar Lake.
Shangrila and Upper Kachura Lake, then another long drive to Hunza.
Attabad Lake, Gulmit, Passu, the Hussaini bridge and Khunjerab Pass.
Altit and Baltit forts and the royal garden, then down to Chilas.
Back over Babusar to Islamabad and on to Lahore.

Uses the Babusar road both ways
